_comment: v3. First two segments passed all 4 guardrail gates cleanly (clean single-band asphalt mask, detect_road agrees with manual measurement, no competing gray structures). garden.png had a painted-in car removed via tools/strip-car.py before being added here.
_chunking: Route is short enough (~2237px stitched) to fit in one chunk, so pick a chunk_height above the whole route height and avoid the boundary-placement problem entirely rather than aim it at a moving target: both segment joins are now hard cuts (0 overlap - garden/garden-beach/beach-cove are three distinct compositions, not continuous terrain), so their rows shift whenever a plate/rows/overlap value changes upstream. An internal chunk boundary that isn't pinned to a hard cut shows as a faint line even when the pixels either side are identical - a browser seam between two separately-rasterized elements, the same class of artifact 25aa6c5 fixed once already by merging chunks. Revisit if the route grows past a few thousand px.

segments._: Section 0 - new opening plate, added ahead of garden.png. Same forest/road as garden.png (all 7 guardrail gates passed: vertical road, painted style and color match confirmed side by side against garden.png's top edge, detect_road agrees with manual measurement (centre ~1377 vs ~1377-1381, width ~156 vs ~153-182), single clean asphalt band with no competing gray structure, native 2752x1536 matching neighbor resolution, terrain genuinely continues into garden.png's opening rather than a hard cut). Painted-in car removed via tools/strip-car.py; its default PAD/feather (26px/14) left a visible seam band on this plate's more mottled road texture, so PAD was widened to 70 and the feather to 40 (both now the script's default) to keep the blend ramp outside the car's own silhouette - narrower feather ghosted the car's pale nose/bumper back in.
opening leg - dense flowering forest, car removed cleanly via strip-car.py. Trimmed shorter so the beach reveal in garden-beach.png comes up sooner.

garden opens out into a beach and turquoise water in the bottom right. garden.png's ending (a rock cluster, sparse trailside flowers) and this plate's top (palms, a different rock arrangement, a path curving in from the left) are different compositions, not the same terrain continuing - the old 200px overlap averaged the two into a soft double-exposure ghost across the seam, wide enough to read as blur. A hard cut (0) instead swapped that for a flat brightness/tone step with no transition, which read as broken too. 32px is short enough that mismatched content doesn't have room to double-expose, while still softening the step into a quick dissolve rather than a jump cut. wide:1758 added to match section 3's canvas width - this plate's own avail (~1906px) supports it, so it's not a crop change, just rendering at the same frame width as beach-cove instead of the narrower 1510 base (which garden.png, the narrowest plate in the route, forces everyone else down to by default).

the offshore islet and second boat this segment is for. Top 450px cropped off. Stops shifted -450 to match. overlap:200 with impose:true - section 2's last 200px are dropped/covered, section 3's own full (post-crop) head is what shows there, genuinely imposed on top. blend:6 (3px/side) - 0 (hard cut) and 14 (soft/flat band) were both tried; 6 softens the seam without the flat-haze look 14 had. wide:1758 (5% narrower than the 1850 that first reached the islet; avail caps at ~1855) so the frame reaches the islet, which sits ~930px right of the road centre. The extra width on garden.png/garden-beach.png's rows is transparent padding, not stretched pixels. Native 2752x1536.

Section 3 - the route continues past the cove into rolling green hills (pines, boulders, wildflowers, matching project/art/hills-l.jpg and hills-r.jpg). All 7 guardrail gates passed: vertical road in a wide canvas, painted style confirmed side by side against beach-cove-v3.png's bottom edge (jungle continues into jungle, sand into sand, the same boat visible at both edges), detect_road agrees with manual measurement (mean centre ~1393 vs ~1391-1393 on clean rows, mean width ~131 vs ~135-138), no car painted in (0 pink-on-road hits, nothing to strip), native 2752x1536 matching every other plate's resolution. The turquoise ocean/boat wake in the top-right corner does form a second low-saturation blob in the asphalt mask, but it sits entirely in the top ~15% of the frame - outside detect_road's own 15%-85% voting window - and never rivals the road's length or width; it did not affect detection. overlap:200 (the manifest default) since this is genuine continuing terrain across the seam, not a hard cut like garden-beach.png needed.
